purpose: Two confirmed representation fixes, a bounded public-teacher correction corpus, and one controlled retention experiment.
regression_fixes: Track per-entry active identity uncertainty separately from prior ability reveals; Corviknight Pressure then Zoroark disguise regression passes.
Represent initial Illusion disguise targets and keep mechanically distinct preview reserve orders.
Reject unrepresentable auxiliary targets and report policy, public-value, private-value, and opponent losses separately.
Update Gym observation space for preview-disguise inputs.

migration.new_inputs: Zero-initialized during explicit migration; no optimizer transferred. Representation fixes alone do not establish improved play.

agreed_targets.saved_team: No regression; report paired uncertainty and retain the frozen baseline if unclear.

metrics: Conditional 2-0 versus 0-2 share on broad/core schedules; saved versus varied; head-to-head against strong frozen opponents. Retain overall wins, splits, draws, and uncertainty. Aggregate confidence resamples all opponents together within each seed.
rejected_inference: A 1-1 split does not establish that team luck caused the result; plateau observations do not prove tuning can never help.

corpus.validation_partition: Every fifth correction game in chronological order; no turns from a held-out game train the policy.

verification.scope: Saved-roster mirror against frozen reference only. This does not establish a better teacher on broad teams.
verification.label_meaning: Public-state preferences of a separately validated teacher, not proofs that every alternative wins.

corpus.limits: Only saved-roster mirror losses against the reference bot. Teacher preferences, not individual counterfactual proofs; ten of fifteen disagreements concern Earthquake versus Outrage. This is not broad tactical coverage.
corpus.recovery: One earlier strict reference deadline was rejected; 26 completed games preserved. Resumed collection completed all 128 games with zero invalid games. See interrupted_attempt.json.

reference_regression.preview: Frozen v6, v7 imitation, pilot 262244, and paused later v7 all choose Gholdengo / Volcarona / Garchomp in the same order.
reference_regression.recurring_difference: In ten inspected positions the learner chose Earthquake with Garchomp against Volcarona while v6 preferred Outrage.
reference_regression.conclusion: Changed preview choice does not explain the saved-mirror regression. Tactical disagreement is a lead, not a demonstrated complete cause.

experiment.variable: Add 5% sampling mass of public-teacher corrections from fresh learner losses; retain earlier data.
experiment.fixed: Same v8 start, 400 updates, seed 942811, LR 1e-5, batch 128, ID dropout 25%; evaluate fixed last weights, not per-arm best-BC selections.
experiment.primary: 2048 head-to-head games (1024 complete seed pairs), treatment versus control. About 80%+ normal-approximation power for a five-point improvement under the conservative maximum pair-score variance; actual power depends on outcome correlation.
experiment.secondary: Broad/core/saved/saved-versus-varied and reference checks, plus 2048 games per arm against the best prior broad-validation checkpoint. Frozen v6 anchors all saved-team checks. Small secondary schedules do not promise five-point precision.
experiment.resources: Sequential jobs; at most two battle/evaluation workers; no overnight PPO or model-size change.
experiment.promotion: No automatic promotion. Best prior broad-validation checkpoint is a comparison opponent, not a proven universal champion. Frozen v6 anchors saved-team retention.

deferred_experiments.terminal_search: Reasonable next strength experiment after the correction comparison: full terminal preview/in-battle rollouts, sampled opposing preview, 64 worlds. Must beat plain policy on a powered paired schedule before becoming a teacher or league opponent.
deferred_experiments.human_replays: Team compositions and public-action targets can be useful now. Approximate imitation masks must be explicitly marked; the existing three-replay probe supplied no BC samples. Scale collection and train a human-like opponent as a separate measured experiment.
deferred_experiments.scaling: Do not combine 10M decisions, a wider four-layer model, or worker-count profiling with this correction ablation. Training remains explicitly paused.
deferred_experiments.public_evidence_beliefs: Speed constraints then uncertain damage likelihoods are reasonable experiments. Require prediction calibration and paired battle gains; do not assume top-three hypotheses cover all damaging moves.
deferred_experiments.public_value_gradients_and_dropout: Public-value detachment is intentional and confirmed by tests. Compare trainable public representation and 0% versus 25% PPO identity dropout separately at equal budgets.
deferred_experiments.independent_policy_and_exploiter: Reasonable bounded population experiment; retain by cross-play diversity at matched budgets after the current comparison.

parallel_legacy_smoke.interpretation: Integration check only, no strength conclusion.
